summary: Implemented parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError in rdflib/extras/shacl.py, with tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (39 tests), and the wider test/test_extras run passes (118 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed). Nothing is committed. mypy, black and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so the type check and formatting were not run; line lengths were checked by hand. Choices: an explicit isinstance(Node) guard before graph lookups (may trip warn_unreachable); IRI heads are returned as predicates, so list tests use blank-node cells; the invalid cases for None, a plain string and a missing lookup are in a separate test; an extra cyclic-list test expects ValueError.
